item.title: Ohio Bill Could Block Wind and Solar and Even Coal
item.description: Ohio bill could sideline wind and solar using a shaky reliability rule and may even snare coal, raising costs and pollution. The post Ohio Bill Could Block Wind and Solar and Even Coal appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: Virginia Data Center Tax Break Bill Pushes Clean Energy Shift
item.description: Virginia lawmakers tie data center tax breaks to cleaner power and efficiency as residents face rising grid and pollution risks. The post Virginia Data Center Tax Break Bill Pushes Clean Energy Shift appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: Mother Elephant Saves Calf From Drowning in River [VIDEO]
item.description: When a young calf is swept off its feet by a sudden river surge, its frantic mother plunges into the churning water. With perfect timing and unwavering determination, she wraps her trunk around her calf and hauls it to safety, proving once again that in the wild, maternal love knows no bounds. The post Mother Elephant Saves Calf From Drowning in River [VIDEO] appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: Basil Balsamic Reduction [Vegan]
item.description: Simmer balsamic vinegar with fresh basil until thick and syrupy, then strain for a glossy, aromatic reduction. Drizzle over roasted veggies, salads or grilled fruits to add a punch of herbal sweetness and tang. The post Basil Balsamic Reduction [Vegan] appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: Eggy Bread With Kala Namak [Vegan, Gluten-Free]
item.description: Whisk chickpea flour, plant milk, kala namak and a pinch of turmeric into a batter, then soak gluten-free bread slices and pan-fry until golden. The sulfurous black salt nails that eggy aroma, making this vegan brunch treat irresistibly authentic. The post Eggy Bread With Kala Namak [Vegan, Gluten-Free] appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: 7 Plant-Based Dumplings From Around the World
item.description: Take your taste buds on a tour with Spanish empanadillas, Chinese jiaozi, Indian samosas, Polish pierogi, Japanese gyoza, South American pastelitos and Italian ravioli—each filled with creative vegan twists like curried lentils, spiced potatoes, cashew ricotta and savory mushrooms. The post 7 Plant-Based Dumplings From Around the World appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: 10 Foods That Keep Digestion on Track
item.description: Incorporate chia seeds, fermented veggies, ginger, papaya, oats, fennel and more—each scientifically shown to balance gut flora, ease bloating and support regularity. Quick tips on serving sizes and prep methods included. The post 10 Foods That Keep Digestion on Track appeared first on One Green Planet.

item.title: 7 Winter Strategies for Healthier Soil & Improving Your Garden Beds
item.description: Cover-crop with clover, layer on compost and straw mulch, test and amend pH, insulate with insulating fabrics, prune spent foliage, build up raised beds and plan crop rotations—all to protect soil life now and hit spring planting running. The post 7 Winter Strategies for Healthier Soil & Improving Your Garden Beds appeared first on One Green Planet.
